title: A clinical trial applying Regulatory T cells in liver transplant recipients to investigate the safety and tolerability when stopping standard immunosuppression.
official: A Phase I/IIa open label single ascending dose study to assess safety and tolerability of regulatory T cells to promote discontinuation of tacrolimus monotherapy in liver transplant recipients - LiveTreg
summary: Main objective: Determine that autologous polyclonal ex-vivo expanded Tregs (Treg02) therapy in liver transplant recipients who are already receiving tacrolimus monotherapy is safe, well tolerated and modulates the immunologic response in the patient to enable permanent withdrawal of immunosuppression
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adult patients (≥18 years of age) with end-stage liver disease who have had single liver transplant
2. Willing and able to give signed and dated informed consent* for participation in the trial participate in the trial
3. Negative SARS-CoV-2 test (depending on current recommendations)
4. No evidence of marked abnormality in latest liver protocol biopsy around 1 year post LT or at inclusion
5. >24 months, < 60 months from the date of liver transplantation
6. Stable liver function as determined by clinical studies; direct bilirubin (< 17.1 µmol/l or 1 mg/dl, total bilirubin < 2.2 mg/dl, albumin > 3 g/l and ALT < 62 IU/l (< 2 ULN).
7. Inflammation grade < 4 and fibrosis stage < 3 in accordance with grading and staging recommendations
8. RAI < 3 at the last biopsy or at inclusion
9. At least 6 months stable on tacrolimus monotherapy with target trough levels of 5 ng/ml without complications
10. No evidence of hepatic autoimmune disease (primary biliary cholangitis, primary sclerosing cholangitis, autoimmune hepatitis)
11. Haematology: Hb ≥ 7.0 g/dl; platelets ≥ 80x10^9/l; total leukocyte count: ≥ 3.0x10^9/l
12. In the investigator’s opinion, is able and willing to comply with all the trial requirements
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patient has previously received any tissue or organ transplant other than single liver transplant
2. HCV-RNA serum positive, HIV positive, HBV surface antigen or HBV-DNA detected in serum at the day of inclusion into the trial
3. Ongoing treatment with systemic immunosuppressive drugs other than tacrolimus at study entry
4. Malignant or pre-malignant haematological conditions. Multiple myeloma, light or heavy chain deposition disease
5. Participation in another clinical trial during the study or within 5 times as the half-life time of the drug used in the previous trial prior to planned study entry
6. Known allergy/hypersensitivity to any component of the study product
7. Known contraindication to the protocol-specified treatments / medications
8. Liver transplant dysfunction defined as fibrosis stage >3, Albumin <3 g/l and ALT >62 IU/l (>2 ULN)
9. Severe irreversible obstructive or restrictive lung disease
10. Previous treatment with any desensitization procedure with or without intravenous immunoglobulin
11. HCC patients with high risk of recurrence as defined >G1/2, >L0, >V0 and > unifocal as defined by Edmondson-Steiner HCC grading scheme
12. Concomitant malignancy or history of malignancy prior to study inclusion in the trial (excluding successfully treated non-metastatic basal/squamous cell carcinoma of the skin, successfully embolized HCC)
13. Active or systemic immune disease that precludes discontinuation of immunosuppression
14. Evidence of significant local or systemic infection
